# Controlled Pilot Observability
Operational metadata only. Do not use this workbook for conversation, draft, token, or document content.

content.query: requests | where timestamp > ago(1h) | summarize total=count(), failures=countif(resultCode startswith '5'), p95=percentile(duration,95) by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName

traces | where timestamp > ago(2h) | where message has 'widget.' or tostring(customDimensions.event_type) has 'widget.' | summarize count() by event=tostring(customDimensions.event_type), bin(timestamp, 5m)

requests | where timestamp > ago(48h) | summarize total=count(), failures=countif(resultCode startswith '5'), p95=percentile(duration,95) by release=tostring(customDimensions['service.version']), bin(timestamp, 30m)
availabilityResults | where timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize availability=avg(toint(success)) by name, bin(timestamp, 15m)
